svg.title: Audion Disk Tools — the mask star on a dark plate
svg.desc: A dark rounded plate over the whole square; a six-ray star exactly in its middle, each ray in a colour of the file families (archives, video, the hour's yellow, audio, graphics, system), a dark hub. Chosen by the owner on 28.09.2026; the orange dot of 5.33.6 in the lower left corner is gone - the star alone.
